<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

class SecureDocumentAPI {
    private $mongo;
    private $db;
    private const MAX_PAGE_SIZE = 50;
    private const CURSOR_EPOCH = 1700000000;
    private const JWT_ALG = 'HS256';
    
    public function __construct() {
        $this->mongo = new MongoDB\Client(getenv('MONGO_URI') ?: 'mongodb://localhost:27017');
        $this->db = $this->mongo->selectDatabase('appdb');
    }
    
    public function handleRequest(): void {
        $method = $_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'];
        if ($method !== 'GET') {
            $this->sendError(405, 'Method not allowed');
            return;
        }
        
        $token = $this->extractBearerToken();
        if (!$token) {
            $this->sendError(401, 'Missing authorization');
            return;
        }
        
        $session = $this->validateSession($token);
        if (!$session) {
            $this->sendError(401, 'Invalid session');
            return;
        }
        
        $path = parse_url($_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'], PHP_URL_PATH);
        $params = $_GET;
        
        switch ($path) {
            case '/api/documents':
                $this->listDocuments($session, $params);
                break;
            case '/api/documents/shared':
                $this->listSharedDocuments($session, $params);
                break;
            default:
                $this->sendError(404, 'Not found');
        }
    }
    
    private function extractBearerToken(): ?string {
        $header = $_SERVER['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION'] ?? '';
        if (preg_match('/^Bearer\s+([a-zA-Z0-9_\-\.]+)$/', $header, $m)) {
            return $m[1];
        }
        return null;
    }
    
    private function validateSession(string $token): ?array {
        $parts = explode('.', $token);
        if (count($parts) !== 3) return null;
        
        // Validate and pin the JWT algorithm from the header to prevent
        // algorithm-confusion / "alg: none" attacks (CWE-347).
        $headerRaw = base64_decode($parts[0], true);
        if ($headerRaw === false) return null;
        $header = json_decode($headerRaw, true);
        if (!is_array($header) || !isset($header['alg'])) return null;
        if (!hash_equals(self::JWT_ALG, (string)$header['alg'])) return null;
        
        $payloadRaw = base64_decode($parts[1], true);
        if ($payloadRaw === false) return null;
        $payload = json_decode($payloadRaw, true);
        if (!$payload || !isset($payload['sub'], $payload['exp'])) return null;
        if ($payload['exp'] < time()) return null;
        
        $secret = getenv('JWT_SECRET');
        if (!$secret) return null;
        
        $providedSig = base64_decode($parts[2], true);
        if ($providedSig === false) return null;
        
        $expectedSig = hash_hmac('sha256', $parts[0] . '.' . $parts[1], $secret);
        if (!hash_equals($expectedSig, $providedSig)) return null;
        
        return [
            'user_id' => $payload['sub'],
            'org_id' => $payload['org'] ?? null,
            'role' => $payload['role'] ?? 'viewer'
        ];
    }
    
    /**
     * Cursor-based pagination using encoded position tokens.
     * Token format: base62(org_boundary_offset XOR timestamp_salt)
     * This prevents users from guessing/manipulating page positions.
     */
    private function decodeCursor(?string $cursor, string $orgId): int {
        if ($cursor === null || $cursor === '') {
            return 0;
        }
        
        // Decode the cursor token
        $decoded = base64_decode($cursor, true);
        if ($decoded === false || strlen($decoded) !== 16) {
            return 0;
        }
        
        // Extract components: 8 bytes offset + 4 bytes salt + 4 bytes checksum
        $components = unpack('Joffset/Nsalt/Nchecksum', $decoded);
        if ($components === false) {
            return 0;
        }
        
        $offset = $components['offset'];
        $salt = $components['salt'];
        $checksum = $components['checksum'];
        
        // Verify checksum integrity
        $expectedChecksum = crc32($orgId . ':' . $offset . ':' . $salt);
        // Use unsigned comparison for CRC32
        if (($checksum & 0xFFFFFFFF) !== ($expectedChecksum & 0xFFFFFFFF)) {
            return 0;
        }
        
        // Validate the salt is within acceptable time window (anti-replay)
        $currentSalt = (int)(time() / 3600);
        if (abs($salt - $currentSalt) > 24) {
            return 0;
        }
        
        // Apply org-specific boundary transform
        $orgHash = crc32($orgId);
        $boundedOffset = $offset ^ ($orgHash & 0xFFFF);
        
        // CRITICAL: Ensure offset is non-negative and within reasonable bounds
        if ($boundedOffset < 0 || $boundedOffset > 10000) {
            return 0;
        }
        
        return $boundedOffset;
    }
    
    private function encodeCursor(int $offset, string $orgId): string {
        $orgHash = crc32($orgId);
        $transformedOffset = $offset ^ ($orgHash & 0xFFFF);
        
        $salt = (int)(time() / 3600);
        $checksum = crc32($orgId . ':' . $transformedOffset . ':' . $salt);
        
        return base64_encode(pack('JNN', $transformedOffset, $salt, $checksum));
    }
    
    private function listDocuments(array $session, array $params): void {
        $orgId = $session['org_id'];
        if (!$orgId) {
            $this->sendError(403, 'No organization context');
            return;
        }
        
        $pageSize = min(
            max((int)($params['limit'] ?? 20), 1),
            self::MAX_PAGE_SIZE
        );
        
        $cursor = $params['cursor'] ?? null;
        $offset = $this->decodeCursor($cursor, $orgId);
        
        // Build the query with org isolation
        $filter = [
            'org_id' => $orgId,
            'deleted' => false,
            'status' => ['$in' => ['published', 'draft']]
        ];
        
        // Role-based visibility
        if ($session['role'] === 'viewer') {
            $filter['status'] = 'published';
        }
        
        $options = [
            'projection' => [
                'title' => 1,
                'status' => 1,
                'created_at' => 1,
                'author' => 1,
                'org_id' => 1
            ],
            'sort' => ['created_at' => -1],
            'skip' => $offset,
            'limit' => $pageSize + 1
        ];
        
        $collection = $this->db->selectCollection('documents');
        $results = $collection->find($filter, $options)->toArray();
        
        $hasMore = count($results) > $pageSize;
        if ($hasMore) {
            array_pop($results);
        }
        
        $documents = array_map(function($doc) {
            return [
                'id' => (string)$doc['_id'],
                'title' => $doc['title'] ?? '',
                'status' => $doc['status'] ?? '',
                'created_at' => $doc['created_at'] ?? '',
                'author' => $doc['author'] ?? ''
            ];
        }, $results);
        
        $response = [
            'documents' => $documents,
            'pagination' => [
                'has_more' => $hasMore,
                'next_cursor' => $hasMore ? $this->encodeCursor($offset + $pageSize, $orgId) : null
            ]
        ];
        
        $this->sendJSON(200, $response);
    }
    
    private function listSharedDocuments(array $session, array $params): void {
        $userId = $session['user_id'];
        
        $pageSize = min(
            max((int)($params['limit'] ?? 20), 1),
            self::MAX_PAGE_SIZE
        );
        
        $filter = [
            'shared_with' => $userId,
            'deleted' => false
        ];
        
        $options = [
            'projection' => [
                'title' => 1,
                'status' => 1,
                'shared_at' => 1,
                'owner' => 1
            ],
            'sort' => ['shared_at' => -1],
            'limit' => $pageSize
        ];
        
        $collection = $this->db->selectCollection('documents');
        $results = $collection->find($filter, $options)->toArray();
        
        $documents = array_map(function($doc) {
            return [
                'id' => (string)$doc['_id'],
                'title' => $doc['title'] ?? '',
                'status' => $doc['status'] ?? '',
                'shared_at' => $doc['shared_at'] ?? '',
                'owner' => $doc['owner'] ?? ''
            ];
        }, $results);
        
        $this->sendJSON(200, ['documents' => $documents]);
    }
    
    private function sendJSON(int $code, array $data): void {
        http_response_code($code);
        header('Content-Type: application/json');
        header('X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff');
        echo json_encode($data, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
    }
    
    private function sendError(int $code, string $message): void {
        $this->sendJSON($code, ['error' => $message]);
    }
}

$api = new SecureDocumentAPI();
$api->handleRequest();
